name: BAYHOST: Scholarships for students and young academics from Central, Eastern and Southeastern Europe for summer language courses
summary: Students and young academics from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, Slovenia and Ukraine with intermediate German knowledge (at least B1-level) are eligible to apply for the summer school
